questions: Did these symptoms begin suddenly, within the last few hours?
Did you develop weakness or loss of coordination on one side of your body?
Did you have facial drooping, slurred speech, difficulty finding words, or trouble understanding speech?
Did you experience sudden numbness or loss of sensation?
Did you develop a sudden severe headache, vision loss, dizziness, or difficulty walking?
Were you unconscious or unable to respond at any point?
Were you fully aware and able to remember what happened during the movements?
Could you stop the movements when asked?
Did the movements lessen or stop when your attention was distracted?
Did the movements worsen when you watched or concentrated on them?
Have you had similar episodes before?
Have you ever been diagnosed with a seizure disorder or another neurological condition?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medications?
Have you used alcohol, recreational drugs, or stimulants recently?
Did these symptoms begin after a frightening, stressful, or emotionally upsetting event?
Have you recently had a head injury, infection, or significant illness?
Do you have a history of stroke, migraine, diabetes, high blood pressure, or heart rhythm problems?
